title: The 3 Best Dog Crates for Anxious Dogs
h1: The 3 Best Dog Crates for Anxious Dogs
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for dog crates for anxious dogs, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at dog crates for anxious dogs using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Carlson Pet Products Double Door Metal Dog Crate, Large 42-Inch
products.blurb: Key specs: Multi-point locking latch system, Heavier wire gauge than entry-level crates, Front and side doors for flexible placement near you.
strengths: Multi-point latches resist the paw-pawing and nose-nudging common during panic
Sturdier wire holds shape better than basic crates under repeated stress
Dual doors let you place the crate where the dog can see you
limitations: Not marketed specifically as anxiety-proof, so severe cases may still need reinforcement
Heavier and pricier than a basic wire crate
Open wire sides still allow visual stimulation unless covered
features: Heavier wire gauge than entry-level crates
Front and side doors for flexible placement near you

products.name: Go Pet Club 44-Inch Heavy Duty Stackable Dog Crate
products.blurb: Key specs: Heaviest wire gauge in this category, 44.25"L x 28"W x 32.5"H with wheels, Removable divider and two water bowls.
strengths: Thickest wire of any crate reviewed on this site, resists bending during panic
Large footprint gives a stressed dog more room to pace without feeling trapped
Wheels let you reposition the crate to a calmer room quickly
limitations: Bulkiest crate here, needs real floor space
Some reports of weld quality issues on individual units
Assembly is easier with two people
features: Heaviest wire gauge in this category
Removable divider and two water bowls

products.name: SportPet Designs Sport Pet Large Portable Kennel
products.blurb: Key specs: Folding wire construction, Indoor and outdoor rated, Carrying handle.
strengths: Lightweight enough to move to whichever room keeps the dog calmest
Budget-friendly for households still figuring out what their dog needs
Folds down small for travel, useful if anxiety is tied to new environments
limitations: Lighter wire gauge is not rated for dogs that bend or chew bars
Not a fit for moderate to severe crate anxiety
Fewer size options than the MidWest or Carlson lines

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
